exposure: days to achieve full enteral feeding
comorbidities of prematurity (moderate-to-severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia, high-grade intraventricular hemorrhage, retinopathy of prematurity)
outcome: weight lower than the 10th centile at evaluation point
age-specific weight Z-scores on evaluation point
change in weight Z-score between birth and evaluation point
cohort: A total of 263 infants born between 2012 and 2020 with birthweight less than 1500 g and gestational age of 24-33 weeks were included.
finding: Extrauterine growth restriction (EUGR) was associated with gestational age, birth weight, intestinal surgery, and longer time to achieve full enteral feeding, while major morbidities of prematurity were linked to slower postnatal growth velocity but not directly to EUGR.
followup_time: up to corrected gestational age 36 weeks or discharge, whichever came first
